Where to Stay in Lampang?
12 Hotels We've Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites
heroSub: Twelve Lampang hotels across every budget — modern and boutique hotels scoring 9.1 in town, teak riverside guesthouses by Kad Kong Ta old town, down to a hostel and value stays from ฿450/night. Covering the old town, the city centre, and the Wang riverside.
introH2: 🏙️ Why does choosing the right base in Lampang matter?
introHtml: Lampang is an easygoing town where most hotels cluster in and around the centre — but each area has its own feel. The old town around Kad Kong Ta, on the Wang River, is the zone of old-wood shophouses, a weekend walking street, and quirky cafés — best if you want to wander and soak up the atmosphere. The city centre around Bunyawat and Phahonyothin roads sits close to markets, malls and restaurants, and is the easiest to get around. And the Wang riverside and outskirts are quiet and restful. Many people book without thinking about which zone they'll explore, then end up driving back and forth to the old town every day. This guide rounds up 12 Lampang hotels we've picked across every tier — from high-scoring modern and boutique hotels down to value guesthouses and a hostel — each with an honest take from real reviews, prices compared on 3 sites, and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Lampang has no metro, but the town is compact and getting around by car or app-ride is easy. The town's signature is its horse-drawn carriages, which still circle the old town for visitors. Lampang Airport (LPT) is about 10 minutes from the centre, and the northern railway stops at Lampang's classic old wooden station. The main bases in this guide: Kad Kong Ta old town — old-wood shophouses, the Wang River, the walking street, cafés · City centre (Bunyawat–Phahonyothin) — markets, malls, restaurants, easy to get around · Wang riverside & outskirts — quiet and restful.

entries.name: The Space Hotel Lampang
entries.revCount: 283 reviews · highest score in this set
entries.addr: 274/1 Chatchai Road, Sob Tui, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: The highest score in this set at 9.1 from 283 reviews — The Space is a modern in-town hotel known for spacious, spotless rooms. The Deluxe rooms are contemporary and include breakfast, and there's a Family Club Suite with a jacuzzi for couples or families. Its Sob Tui location makes it easy to reach the centre and head out of town. Real reviews praise the room size, cleanliness and attentive staff — a comfortable, easy base in the city.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a couple or family, step up to the Family Club Suite with a jacuzzi — better value than two rooms. It works well as a base for driving to the old town and around Lampang.
pros: Highest score in the set, 9.1 from 283 reviews
Spacious, modern rooms, breakfast included
Family Club Suite with jacuzzi, great for families
Reviews praise the cleanliness and service
cons: An in-town hotel, no natural views
Popular suites book up fast on weekends — reserve ahead

entries.name: Tree Thara Hotel
entries.addr: 1/1 Super Highway Road (Lampang-Ngao), Chomphu, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: Tree Thara is a boutique hotel scoring 9.1, tied for first, from 173 reviews. Its draw is warm-toned rooms, some with mountain views; the 26-sqm Classic King includes breakfast for two, and there's a Honeymoon Suite with a soaking tub for couples. Sitting on the Super Highway, it's easy to drive into town and out again. Real reviews praise the clean, restful rooms, the breakfast and the quiet — a good pick for couples and families arriving by car.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Couples should try the Honeymoon Suite with its soaking tub. Ask for a mountain-view room when you book, and note there's parking — handy if you're on a road trip.
pros: Scores 9.1, tied for first, from 173 reviews
Warm-toned rooms, some with mountain views
Breakfast included · Honeymoon Suite with soaking tub
Reviews praise cleanliness and the quiet
cons: On the Super Highway — easier to drive into the old town than walk
Popular rooms book up fast on weekends — reserve ahead

entries.name: Huglampang Boutique Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Old town · near Kad Kong Ta
entries.addr: 57, 59, 61 Thipchang Road, Hua Wiang, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: Huglampang is a boutique hotel in the old town near Kad Kong Ta, scoring 8.8 from 142 reviews. Its draw is the location — you can walk to the Kad Kong Ta walking street and the heritage cafés — plus every room has a private balcony and a rain shower, all from just ฿650. Real reviews praise the walkable old-town setting, clean rooms and value. A good pick if you want to soak up old-town Lampang on a budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Kad Kong Ta walking street runs on Saturday and Sunday nights, right from your doorstep. Ask for a balcony room on the quiet side for the full old-town atmosphere.
pros: Old-town location near Kad Kong Ta, walk to the walking street
Every room has a private balcony and a rain shower
Great-value starting price for the old town
Reviews praise cleanliness and the location
cons: A small boutique — no pool or big-hotel services
Parking is limited in the old town — ask ahead

entries.name: The Riverside Guest House
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Talat Kao Rd · Wang River, old town
entries.addr: 286 Talat Kao Road, Suan Dok, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: The Riverside is a teak guesthouse on the Wang River with the most reviews in this set — 1,198, scoring 8.7. Its draw is the colonial old-wood atmosphere right on the river, near Kad Kong Ta and the walking street. Rooms range from simple fan rooms at the budget end to air-con rooms with old-wood decor, up to a Colonial Suite with a river-view balcony. Real reviews praise the riverside setting, the walkable old town and the riverside restaurant. A good pick if you want a genuine old-town-on-the-river feel.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Rooms vary a lot — fan or air-con, private or shared bathroom — so check the room type carefully before booking. For a river view, pick a Superior or the Colonial Suite on the riverside.
pros: Most reviewed in the set, 1,198 reviews — lots of real data
Old teak building on the Wang River, genuine old-town feel
Near Kad Kong Ta and the walking street
Rooms at every price level, from budget fan rooms to a riverside suite
cons: Fan / shared-bathroom rooms are simple — check the type before booking
It's an old wooden building, so you may hear neighbouring rooms

entries.name: Lampang Residence
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sob Tui · near the bus terminal
entries.addr: 136/98 Phaholyothin Road, Sob Tui, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: Lampang Residence is a value hotel with a huge 1,212 reviews, scoring 8.6. Its draw is large rooms — around 45 sqm — with balconies, breakfast included, and a Sob Tui location near Lampang's bus terminal for easy onward travel. There's a mountain-view King room and a Family Room too. Real reviews praise rooms that feel bigger than the price, the cleanliness and the value. A good pick for travellers who want a big, cheap room near the bus terminal.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Rooms here are noticeably bigger than other hotels at the same price. Ask for the mountain-view King for a nicer balcony, and it's handy if you arrive by long-distance coach.
pros: Heavily reviewed, 1,212 reviews, great-value starting price
Large rooms around 45 sqm with balconies, breakfast included
Near the bus terminal for easy onward travel
Reviews praise the room size and value
cons: A budget hotel — decor is functional
A fair way from the Kad Kong Ta old town — you'll need a ride

entries.name: Lampang River Lodge - Lanna Riverside Resort
entries.revCount: 62 reviews · riverside resort on the edge of town
tags: 🛏️ Some rooms have a riverside balcony
entries.storyHtml: Lampang River Lodge is a Lanna boutique resort on the Wang River, on the edge of town, scoring 8.6 from 62 reviews. Its draw is the teak-toned Lanna houses, a quiet riverside garden, and a Lakeview Deluxe with a balcony over the water. It suits travellers who want a quiet resort feel close to nature, away from the bustle in town. Real reviews praise the riverside setting, the calm and the Lanna styling. A good pick for couples and those arriving by car.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a river view, pick the Lakeview Deluxe With Balcony. It's on the outskirts, so having your own car helps, and the early-morning view over the Wang River is the highlight.
pros: On the Wang River, a quiet garden setting
Teak-toned Lanna houses with real character
Some rooms have a balcony over the river, good for relaxing
Reviews praise the quiet and the riverside atmosphere
cons: On the outskirts — you'll need to drive to the old town and centre
Riverside rooms are limited and fill up fast on weekends

entries.name: At Home Boutique
entries.addr: 171/1 Thanon Sooksawat 1 Soi 9, Phrabat, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: At Home Boutique is an in-town boutique known for big rooms and value, scoring 8.4 from 197 reviews. Its draw is spacious Deluxe rooms — around 30 sqm — with a balcony in every room, from just ฿700. The Sooksawat Road location keeps you central and easy to get around. Real reviews praise the room size, cleanliness and value. A good pick if you want a big room at a budget price in town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Rooms here are bigger than the price suggests. Ask for the Deluxe Balcony for a sitting nook by the balcony, and there's convenient parking for those driving.
pros: Spacious rooms around 30 sqm, every room has a balcony
Great-value starting price for an in-town boutique
Central location, easy to get around
Reviews praise the room size and cleanliness
cons: A small boutique — no pool or big-hotel services
A fair way from the Kad Kong Ta old town — you'll need a ride

entries.name: B2 Lampang Boutique & Budget Hotel
entries.addr: 64 Ban Dong Phatthana Road, Bo Haeo, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: B2 Lampang is a budget-chain hotel and the cheapest in this set, from just ฿525, scoring 8.4 from 511 reviews. Its draw is clean, reliably standardised B2 rooms at a budget price, with both doubles and Triples for groups of friends. The Bo Haeo location at the town entrance has parking, handy if you're driving. Real reviews praise the value, cleanliness and low price. A good pick for travellers who just want a clean bed at a budget price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Three of you? The Triple beats two rooms. It's at the town entrance, so having a car helps, and it makes a handy stopover heading north.
pros: Cheapest in the set at ฿525, heavily reviewed with 511 reviews
Clean rooms to the reliable B2 chain standard
Triple and Luxury Triple rooms for groups
Parking available, good for drivers
cons: On the outskirts at the town entrance — you'll drive into the centre
Plain budget-chain decor

entries.name: Wienglakor Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phahonyothin Rd · Suan Dok, city centre
entries.addr: 138/35 Phahonyothin Road, Suan Dok, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: Wienglakor is a 4-star Lanna-style hotel in the centre of Lampang, scoring 8.3 from 45 reviews. Its draw is the teak-wood Lanna decor, a swimming pool, and Connecting Rooms for families. The Phahonyothin Road location is central, close to malls and restaurants and easy to get around. Real reviews praise the Lanna atmosphere, cleanliness and central setting. A good pick if you want an in-town hotel with a pool and a local feel.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Families can take a Connecting Room linking two rooms. The pool is rare for a central Lampang hotel, so it's handy if you're bringing kids.
pros: Teak-wood Lanna decor, a local atmosphere
Has a pool — rare for a central hotel
Connecting rooms for families
Central location on Phahonyothin Road, easy to get around
cons: An older hotel — some fittings show their age
Few reviews (45) compared with others in the set

entries.name: Lampang Vintage
entries.addr: 590 Moo 3, Thanon Prabaht, Ban Tok Hua Chang, Phrabat, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: Lampang Vintage is a budget hotel in Phrabat near Lampang Airport, scoring 8.2 from 65 reviews. Its draw is that some rooms have a balcony looking out over rice paddies and mountains, breakfast is included, and prices start at just ฿550. The location near the airport suits those flying in and out of Lampang or stopping over before moving on. Real reviews praise the value, cleanliness and the quiet paddy views. A good pick for budget travellers near the airport.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pay a little more for the paddy-view Double for a nicer balcony view. The airport-side location is handy for an early or late flight.
pros: Budget starting price of ฿550, breakfast included
Some rooms have a balcony with paddy and mountain views
Near Lampang Airport, handy for flyers
Reviews praise the value and the quiet
cons: In the Phrabat outskirts — you'll drive into the centre and old town
A budget stay with plain decor

entries.name: Asia Lampang Hotel
entries.revCount: 320 reviews · heart of the old quarter
entries.addr: 229 Bunyawat Road, Suan Dok, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: Asia Lampang is a long-standing hotel in the heart of town on Bunyawat Road, scoring 8.0 from 320 reviews. Its draw is the central location — you can walk to markets and local restaurants — with spacious rooms from just ฿650. It's a hotel that's been part of Lampang for years, with an old-quarter feel right in the centre. Real reviews praise the walkable central setting, the room size and the value. A good pick if you want to stay central and walk to the market on a budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The central location puts markets and local restaurants within walking distance. Ask for a room on the quiet side away from the main road, and step up to a Deluxe (newer) if your budget allows.
pros: Central location in the Bunyawat quarter, walk to the market
Spacious rooms, great-value starting price
Heavily reviewed with 320 reviews
Near local restaurants and street food in the centre
cons: A long-standing hotel — some fittings show their age
Rooms facing the main road can be noisy — ask for the quiet side

entries.name: Old Town Boutique Hostel
entries.revCount: 188 reviews · hostel by Kad Kong Ta
entries.mrtTag: 📍 By Kad Kong Ta · old town
entries.addr: 7 Talad Gao Road, Suan Dok, Mueang Lampang
entries.storyHtml: Old Town Boutique Hostel is a hostel in an old wooden building by Kad Kong Ta, the cheapest in this set from just ฿450, scoring 8.0 from 188 reviews. Its draw is the high-ceilinged old-building atmosphere in the old quarter — step out the door and you're at Kad Kong Ta and the walking street. There are dorm beds for backpackers and private double rooms too. Real reviews praise the walkable old-town location, the old-building character and the low price. A good pick for budget travellers who want to stay right in the old town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Solo backpackers get the best deal with a dorm bed at ฿450. Want more privacy? Step up to a Double or Triple — some have a private bathroom.

Step out the door to the walking street and old town
High-ceilinged old wooden building with character
Both dorm beds and private rooms
cons: It's a hostel — some rooms share a bathroom, check the type before booking

faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about Lampang hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in around Lampang?
faq.a: It depends on your style. The Kad Kong Ta old town on the Wang River suits those who want to wander among old-wood shophouses, the walking street and cafés (Huglampang, The Riverside, Old Town Hostel). The city centre around Bunyawat and Phahonyothin suits those who want to be close to markets, malls and restaurants (The Space, Wienglakor, Asia Lampang). And the Wang riverside and outskirts suit a quiet, restful stay (Lampang River Lodge).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Lampang hotels cost?
faq.a: Lampang is great value: hostels and budget stays start around ฿450–650 a night; quality boutiques and 3-star hotels run about ฿650–1,200; a 4-star hotel with a pool starts around ฿1,000 and up. The prices in this guide are starting rates for standard rooms — they can run higher in the cool season and on long weekends.

faq.q: ❓ Do I need a car in Lampang, and how essential is it?
faq.a: The centre and the Kad Kong Ta old town are easy to explore on foot, and Lampang's signature horse-drawn carriages circle the old town. But for sights around the province — like Wat Phra That Lampang Luang — or for stays on the outskirts, having your own car or an app-ride is much more convenient. The airport is just about 10 minutes from the centre.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Lampang hotel?
faq.a: For ordinary weekdays, 1–2 weeks ahead is plenty, since Lampang has lots of good-value rooms. But in the cool season (Nov–Jan), on long weekends and during festivals, the good rooms — especially in the old town and by the river — fill up fast, so book 2–4 weeks ahead or more.

faq.q: ❓ Kad Kong Ta old town or the city centre — which is better?
faq.a: The Kad Kong Ta old town is best if your trip is about wandering the old-wood shophouses, the weekend walking street, cafés and the Wang River — though parking is limited. The city centre suits those who want to be near markets, malls and restaurants and to drive out of town easily — but it has less old-town atmosphere. Lampang is small, so it's only a few minutes' drive between the two.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking a Lampang hotel?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) vary with their current promotions, so it's worth opening all three to compare before you book. Every review page in this guide has price-comparison links — it can save you a few hundred baht a night.
